source: A note from kecskepasztor
target: Notula a kecskepasztor

source: Hello everybody!
target: Salvete omnes!

source: This is a Thursday release!
target: Haec emissio die Iovis est!

source: Spoiler Ah the cliché bandits, in serious need of acting classes!
target: Heu, latrones stereotypos, qui ad lectiones scaenicas egent!

source: If you see any grammar (or another kind) mistake, please don't hesitate to point it out in the comments!
target: Si aliqua errata grammaticae (vel alicuius generis) conspicias, quaeso, ne dubita ea in commentariis indicare!

source: Schedule will be Monday/Thursday at minimum, but if I write more then I will post more!
target: Schedula saltem Lunae et Iovis erit, sed si plura scribam, plura publicabo!

source: Have fun, and have a nice day!
target: Divertimini, et habeatis diem iucundum!

source: Having Lucky’s race turn from Forest Wolf to Mana Wolf was a small boon.
target: Conversio generis Lucky ab Lupo Silvestri ad Lupum Mana modicum auxilium erat.

source: It would increase the level limit a little.
target: Hoc modicum finem gradus parum auget.

source: Not much, as the maximum level of a Forest Wolf was 15, at which point Lucky would have turned into an Alpha Forest Wolf, instead his level cap would increase.
target: Non nimis, nam gradus maximus Lupi Silvestri erat quindecim, quo facto Lucky in Luper Alpha Silvestris verti debuisset; proinde eius gradus capitus augere debebat.

source: Though Sam didn’t exactly know by how much.
target: Attamen Sam non exacte sciebat quantum.

source: Based on the general knowledge he got, the increase was maybe 5 or at maximum, 10 levels.
target: Ex notitia generalis, quam accepit, incrementum fortasse quinque vel ad summam decem gradus esse aestimabatur.

source: Even that would make Lucky more useful in the short term, and grant him more time to prepare for proper evolution.
target: Etiam id Lucky in brevi tempore utiliorem reddit atque ei plura tempora ad evolutionem rectam praeparandam concedit.

source: Not that he would get rid of Lucky for any reason.
target: Non enim Lucky quocumque causa amitteret.

source: The excitable fluff ball was coming with him, even if the wolf would become useless in fights.
target: Illa globus pilosus excitabilis secum se feret, etiam si lupus in pugnis inutilis fateri videbatur.

source: Fluff was love.
target: Pilositas erat amor.

source: Fluff was life.
target: Pilositas erat vita.

source: Sam watched as the energized Lucky tore through the monsters of the forest with a small smile.
target: Sam spectavit, cum Lucky energizatus per monstra silvae lacessos parvo subridente confregeret.

source: While the wolf’s new capability with mana didn’t mean much, with Deep Connection he would soon learn to use it enough to strengthen his body and maybe execute a few mana-based attacks.
target: Quamquam nova potentia lupi cum manā parum videbatur, cum Coniunctione Profunda mox illa uti discebisset ad corpus suum firmandum et fortasse nonnullos ictus manae exsequi.

source: Sam absentmindedly deflected an attack from a stealthy fox that jumped at him from a nearby bush, his Mana Sense pinpointing the position of his attacker before it even decided to attack him, as he thought about Lucky.
target: Sam, absens mente, impetum a vulpe callida, quae ex fronde proxima in eum saltavit, repulit, dum Sensus Manæ locum aggressoris antequam impetum iungere decrevisset designavit, dum de Lucky cogitabat.

source: Now that he was done with that, he would only need to reach level 15, get a courier mission towards one of the nearest cities, and get out of the tutorial.
target: Iam id confectum habens, solum ei opus erat ut gradus quindecim attingeret, missionem cursoriae ad unum ex urbibus proximis obtineret, atque oppidum praeceptorum relinqueret.

source: While he definitely wasn’t the fastest to leave the tutorial, Sam knew that by dedicating oneself to grinding, one could reach the necessary level and leave the tutorial area within a few real-life days- And with the help of a guild or gaming studio? In mere hours, if they were good.
target: Quamquam certe non celerissimus ad oppidum praeceptorum exire poterat, Sam sciebat quod, studio terens, quis gradum necessarium attingere et regionem praeceptorum intra paucos dies in re vera relinquere posset – et auxilio sodalium vel studii ludici? In paucis horis, si optimi fuerunt.

source: But that was the magic of Magic Unbound.
target: At illud erat miraculum Magic Unbound.

source: It didn’t reward the highest leveled people.
target: Non praemia dabat hominibus summis gradibus.

source: The game designers were thinking long-term.
target: Conditores ludi longae temporis cogitabant.

source: Slow and steady exploration, building a proper foundation, and social connections were more important than the race to the top.
target: Lenta et constans exploratio, bona fundamenta exstruenda, ac nexus sociales magni momenti erant quam cursor ad apicem.

source: And that would cripple a lot of currently high leveled players.
target: Et id multos lusores iam alti gradus habentes claudebit.

source: According to his memories, not an insignificant number of them would simply restart when they realized that they essentially gimped their characters.
target: Secundum memorias eius, non pauci inter eos iterum inciperent, cum intellexerunt se in sua figura re vera debilitatos esse.

source: Not that they couldn’t have corrected their build and learned the required skills to be useful, but the time investment required was more than anybody was willing to invest.
target: Non quod structuram corrigere neque artes necessarias ad esse utiles discere non potuissent, sed tempus impensus superabat omnem voluntatem.

source: But Sam wasn’t worried about anything like that.
target: Sed Sam de talibus nihil curabat.

source: He gathered the skills he needed, and some he didn’t even know he could get, so he was happy.
target: Artes quas opus habebat collegit, et aliquas quas ne sciebat habere quidem possent, ita laetus erat.

source: And the moment Lucky took down the latest oversized hog, a notification rang out, and a window appeared in front of him.
target: Et momento quo Lucky recentissimum porcum nimis magnum deiecit, nuntius sonuit, et fenestra coram eo apparuit.

source: [You are now level 15!]
target: [Iam gradus 15 es!]

source: [Thanks to your daring handling of mana, you gained +1 WIS!]
target: [Gratia audaci manipulatione manae, +1 Sapientia adeptus es!]

source: [You gained 2 Unassigned status points!]
target: [2 puncta status non assignata adeptus es!]

source: He read the window, then simply closed it.
target: Fenestrae epistolas legit, deinde eam simpliciter claudidit.

source: The game didn’t tell him that he reached the level where he could leave the tutorial town.
target: Ludus non narravit ei se ad gradum pervenisse quo oppidum praeceptorum relinquere posset.

source: It would be handled in-game.
target: Id in ludo agitaretur.

source: Maybe a trainer would realize that he was strong enough to leave, or an important figure would find him to deliver something far away.
target: Fortasse aliquis instructor intellexerit eum satis validum esse ut exiveret, aut figura momenti eum inveniret ad aliquid procul tradendum.

source: But no matter what, the moment he returned to the town, his time was limited.
target: Sed quidquid eveniret, momento quo ad oppidum rediret, tempus eius limitatum esset.

source: Even if he stayed out of the town, sooner or later, the system would have had enough and would engineer some kind of event that would chase him out of the tutorial area.
target: Etiam si extra oppidum mansis, celeriter aut sero, ratio sufficere potuerit et aliquod eventum concinnasset quod eum ex regione praeceptorum expelleret.

source: Sam returned to Greenwood without any fanfare.
target: Sam ad Greenwood rediit sine aliqua pompa.

source: Granted, the area outside of the town was almost teeming with new players, while the wildlife was desperately trying to survive.
target: Admitte, regio extra oppidum fere nova lusoribus referta erat, dum fauna saltem conata est superesse.

source: Thankfully, the rabbits present were a hardy species and would bounce back once the locusts left.
target: Gratias Deo, cuniculi ibi presentes arcta specie erant et reviviscent, cum locustae discesserint.

source: He greeted the gate guard, who was actually doing their job, and not napping.
target: Portam custodem salutavit, qui re vera officium suum exercebat et non dormiebat.

source: Then he headed for the butcher, where he deposited his loot for processing.
target: Deinde ad macellarium accessit, ubi praeda sua ad processum deposuit.

source: After thanking the butcher for his help, and receiving a simple grunt, he went to the Merchant Association and sold the hides, and while he was tempted to get rid of some useless loot from the bandit hideout; he knew that would be social suicide in this town.
target: Macellario gratias egeret et ex grummi simili auditum accepit, deinde ad Societatem Mercatoriam ivit et pellibus vendidit, et, quamquam temptatus est non utilem praedam ex latibulo latronum abicere, scivit hoc in hoc oppido suicidium sociale fore.

source: Plus, he had collected enough gold from the criminals that he had no need for more in the short term.
target: Praeterea, satis aurum a sceleratis collegerat, ut amplius non opus esset in brevi termino.

source: Then he returned to the library to study a little more while the butcher worked.
target: Deinde ad bibliothecam rediit ut paulo amplius studeret, dum macellarius laborabat.

source: He still needed to say goodbye to Sarah at the Green Stump Inn, and Sam wanted to do it with a proper gift.
target: Eamque se valedixisse ad Sarah apud Hospitium Radicis Viridis oportebat, et Sam id cum dono apto facere volebat.

source: A few hours later, he was standing in front of the inn, bag heavy with prime cuts.
target: Nonnullis horis post, ante hospitium stabat, sacculo grave cum optimis frustis.

source: The moment the door opened, she looked up, and when she spotted him, Sarah smiled.
target: Mox ianua aperta est, illa surrexit, et cum eum deprehenderet, Sarah subridet.

source: “Sam!” she called out, placing the book down and standing up. “Welcome back!”
target: “Sam!” inquit, librum deponens et surrecta, “Gratum te revidere!”

source: The people closest to the door looked up, but when they saw him and Lucky, they simply went back to their discussions or meals. He was, after all, a regular and nothing interesting…
target: Homines prope ianuam surrexerunt, sed cum eum et Lucky vidissent, redierunt ad colloquia aut cibaria sua. Erat, post omnia, solitus et nihil insigne…

source: He returned the smile and stepped up to the counter.
target: Ille risum reddidit et ad tabernam accessit.

source: “Hello, Sarah!”
target: “Salve, Sarah!”

source: “What can I do for you, honey?” asked the woman, giving him a once over, while also glancing at the visibly grown Lucky, who just gave her a wolfish grin.
target: “Quid faciam tibi, cara?” inquit illa, eum celeriter pervidens, dum etiam Lucky, palam crevitum, ei vulturiconem risum dabat.

source: “I… came by to say goodbye,” he said haltingly. “Leaving town soon.” Then he took off the bag he was carrying on his shoulder and held it out for her. “Also, here, a little gift.”
target: “Veni ut vale dicam,” inquit hesitanter, “mox oppidum relinquam.” Tum sacculum, quem in umero portabat, detraxit et ei protulit. “Praeterea, ecce, parvus donum.”

source: “Thank you, honey.” Then she put down the bag behind the counter and reached down with one hand. When Sam could see the hand again, it was holding a letter.
target: “Gratias tibi, cara.” Tum sacculum post tabernam deponit et manu una se inclinavit. Cum Sam manum iterum videre potuit, ea epistulam tenebat.

source: “Here, I prepared something for you.”
target: “Hic, tibi aliquid praeparavi.”

source: “You knew?”
target: “Sciebas?”

source: Sarah just snorted.
target: Sarah sufflavit.

source: “Young man! I’ve been here for a long time. I know about the call of adventure.”
target: “Iuvenis! Hic diu maneo. Scio de voco adventus.”

source: Sam took in Sarah’s impish smile and took the letter with a quiet thanks.
target: Sam subrisum impium Sarah intulit et epistulam tacite accepit.

source: “It’s an introduction to a friend in the city of Ironwood,” she continued. “She also owns an inn, though it’s more for long-term lodging than temporary, like mine. If you give her the letter – you can find the address on it – she will give you a discount, and maybe some more…” she finished with a suggestive wink.
target: “Est introductio ad amicum in urbe Ferri ligno,” illa continuavit. “Ea etiam hospitium possidet, quamquam magis ad diuturnam habitationem quam ad temporariam, sicut meum. Si ei epistulam dederis – inscriptionem in ea invenies – discountum tibi dabit, et forsitan amplius…” finivit illa cum oculo suggestivo micante.

source: Sam just stared at her for a moment before pocketing the letter.
target: Sam per momentum eam contemplatus, deinde epistulam in sinum recondidit.

source: “Thank you for your help, Sarah. I appreciate it.”
target: “Gratias tibi pro auxilio, Sarah. Hoc aestimo.”

source: “Don’t mention it, honey! Just go and make me proud out there!” she exclaimed, looking pumped as if she was the one going on an adventure.
target: “Noli de hoc dicere, cara! Ege et me laude imple!” inquit illa, viso quasi ipsa in adventum profectura.

source: Sam nodded with a smile.
target: Sam annuens cum risu dixit: “Faciam. Gratias tibi!”

source: And with that, he turned around and headed for the door. Lucky looked after his master, then at Sarah, and quickly darted behind the counter to rub against the owner of the inn, then ran after Sam, leaving a chuckling woman behind.
target: Et eo facto, conversus ad ianuam contendit. Lucky dominum suum spectavit, deinde ad Sarah, et celeriter post tabernam confugit ut contra dominum hospitii se flecteret, deinde post Sam cucurrit, relinquens mulierem subridentem.

source: “Hey, you! Stop!”
target: “Heus, tu! Cesse!”

source: He turned and saw two people in black clothing running at him. He blinked in surprise and was about to give Lucky the order to run, as he had a bad feeling, when an arrow whizzed past his face, coming from behind.
target: Conversus vidit duo homines veste nigra in eum currentes. Obmutescente miratusque fere paratum esse ut Lucky imperium daret currere, cum mala foedera sensit, cum sagitta per faciem eius volitavit, e tergo veniens.

source: For a moment, he froze, but then Sam moved.
target: Momento sistit, sed deinde Sam se movit.

source: Surreptitiously taking a stance that would leave him stable and ready to respond to more attacks, he slightly turned his head and glanced behind him, seeing two people approaching, one of them holding a bow, both of them grinning.
target: Fallaciter statu sumens quod eum firmum et paratum ad ulteriora impetum respondendum relinqueret, modice caput vertit et surrexit ad posterius, duos homines appropinquantes videns; unus eorum arcum tenebat, amboque risu contrectantes.

source: The two bandits arrived in front of him, breathing heavily yet grinning as they raised their weapons. One was holding an ax, caked with a mysterious substance, while the other held a sword. The one behind him, not holding a bow, was playing with a dagger.
target: Hi duo currentes coram eum pervenerunt, et, paulo graviter spirantes, tamen risu manentes arma sua elevaverunt. Unus eorum securim tenebat, quod aliquo mysterioso materia opertum erat (quamquam Sam de origine eius suspicabatur), et alter gladium tenebat. Is qui post eum stabat, arcum non tenens, cum pugione luserat.

source: Altogether, a pretty stereotypical bandit party made up of players.
target: Omnino, coetus latronum stereotipicus satis erat. Ex lusoribus compositus.

source: To someone new, they would be indistinguishable from NPCs, but to Sam, thanks to his inherited memories, they were quite obvious. Random fragments of their armor and their behavior were very telling, and most importantly, they didn’t know that the kingdom’s knights regularly patrolled this road and were harsh on any bandits.
target: Aliquis novi eos a NPC distinguere non posset, sed Sam, gratias memoriam hereditariam, eos perspicue intellexit. Fragmenta armorum aleatoria et eorum mores satis indicabant. Et, maxime, nesciebant equites regni hanc viam regulariter inspexisse, et contra quascumque latrones repugnare satis aspera.

source: No sane NPC bandit would set up shop here. And if an insane NPC had settled here, Sam would have been killed, teleported to some random location or plane, or perhaps trapped in a nightmarish illusion.
target: Nullus latro NPC rationabilis hic forum condere posset. Et si quidam NPC insanus hic consederet, Sam iam interfectus aut ad locum fortuitum aut planum teletransportatus fuisset, aut fortasse in aliquo phantasmate nocturno captus.

source: While his mind was racing, the bandits began speaking.
target: Dum mens eius celeriter curreret, latrones verba incipiebant.

source: The one holding the ax smiled at him.
target: Is qui securim tenebat ei subridit.

source: “Hello, friend. It seems you arrived at a place where you have to pay the new toll!”
target: “Salve, amice. Videtur te pervenisse ad locum ubi novum vectigal solvere debes!”

source: Sam decided to play along while he stealthily began activating his skills.
target: Sam, adhuc, decrevit se ludere, dum clam incipiebat artes suas activare.

source: “A toll? Nobody said anything about a toll!”
target: “Vectigal? Nemo quid de vectigali dixerat!”

source: The man continued to grin, while the other, believing himself stealthy, began to fan out around him.
target: Ille vir tantum risu continuavit, dum alter, se callide putans, circa eum dispergebat.

source: “It’s a rather new thing, my friend,” he explained, subtly raising his ax.
target: “Res nova satis est, amice,” explicavit, subtiliter securim levans.

source: Sam gave him a wry smile.
target: Sam ei risum sardonicum reddidit.

source: “I see. And may I ask what this toll would cost me?”
target: “Intellego. Et licetne rogar quid hoc vectigal mihi constaret?”

source: The grin on the bandits’ faces grew even bigger.
target: Risus in faciebus latronum et eorum amicorum ancora amplius crevit.

source: “Why everything!”
target: “Quaeque res!” inquit praevidens.

source: Sam sighed.
target: Sam tantum suspiravit.

source: “You guys are pretty bad at this bandit stuff…”
target: “Vos valde male in his latronum artibus laboratis…”

source: The grins vanished, and the man with the ax scowled at him.
target: Risus in faciebus eorum evanuit, et vir securi ei vultum truculenter ferebat.

source: “Shut up! There are four of us, and one of you. And I know that those wolves only go up to level 15. Do as I say, and you won’t die. Don’t and enjoy the timeout…”
target: “Tace! Quattuor sumus et unus tu. Et scio illos lobos solum usque ad gradum 15 pervenire. Fac ut dico, et non morieris. Noli, et fruere paupertate temporaria…” inquit, paene minatione versa.

source: But to Sam, it just seemed so stupid.
target: Sed Sam illud tam stupidum videbatur.

source: Sam sighed again and blatantly looked at each of them, noting their position, then spoke up.
target: Sam iterum suspiravit et aperte singulos aspexit, ordinem eorum notans, deinde locutus est.

source: “Next time, take some acting classes because this was pretty cringe!”
target: “Proxima vice, classes scaenicas capite, quia hoc vere turpe fuit!”

source: “What?”
target: “Quid?”

source: Instead of answering the confused bandits, he moved.
target: Pro responsione latronum incertorum, movebat.

source: Sam raised a hand and blasted the bandit holding the bow with a simple Mana pulse, throwing him back, then called out to Lucky.
target: Sam manum attulit et latronum qui arcum tenebat cum simplice impulso manae percussit, eum retrorsum iactans, deinde Lucky vocavit.

source: “Lucky, kill!”
target: “Lucky, occide!”

source: He unsheathed his sword, coated it in mana, and parried a strike from the only bandit who reacted to his attack.
target: Simul gladium extraxit, manā percussit, et ictum ab unico latrone qui ad acitionem eius respondit paravit.

source: The other two just stared at him with slack jaws, probably in disbelief at his audacity.
target: Reliqui duo eum cavatis mandibulis aspiciebant. Fortasse propter audaciam eius, non celeriter desistendi. Insoliti…

source: Their ally on the ground screamed as Lucky’s jaw struck the man’s throat, and Sam had to parry several more strikes from the man with a sword while the other two finally recovered and raised their weapons.
target: Amicus eorum in terra exclamavit, cum mandibula Lucky in gutture viri incidit. Et Sam plura ictus ab illo, qui gladium tenebat, parare debuit, dum reliqui duo tandem stupefactos expellerunt et arma sua elevaverunt.

source: Sam grinned at them and gripped his sword tighter, while his other hand glowed with magic.
target: Sam eis subridens gladium firmius tenebat, dum altera manus eius magica lucebat.

source: ‘This is going to be awesome!”
target: ‘Hoc mirabile futurum est!’

source: Pet: Adult Gray Mana Wolf - Lucky - (Level 15)
target: Amicus: Lupus Mana Vir Adultus – Lucky – (Gradus 15)

source: [Strong Jaw: Level Max (Passive) The jaw of the wolf is strengthened.]
target: [Strong Jaw: Gradus Maximus (Passivum) – Mandibula lupi roborata est.]

source: [Lucky Aura: Level Max (Passive) Those who are in the same party as the wolf receive a buff to their luck. It depends on their luck and how big the increase is.]
target: [Lucky Aura: Gradus Maximus (Passivum) – Qui in eadem parte cum lupo sint, augmentum fortunae accipiunt.]

source: [Animalistic Mana Control: Level Max (Passive) The wolf controls the mana inside him based on animalistic instinct.]
target: [Animalistic Mana Control: Gradus Maximus (Passivum) – Lupus manam intra se regit secundum instinctum bestialem.]

target: Name: Solar

target: Level: 15 (1%)

target: Title: Magical Genius

source: [Mana Shield: Level 21 (77%) Using mana, you can form a simple shell around yourself, which decreases the damage you take. Damage decrease depends on the amount of mana invested. For every unit of Mana invested in the spell, the shield will protect you from 2,1 (physical) damage.]
target: [Mana Shield: Gradus 21 (77%) – Uti manā, potes testam simplicem circa te efficere, quae damnum minuit. Pro qualibet unitate manae in incantatione collocatae, scutum te ab 2,1 damno physico proteget.]

source: [Controlled Mana Shield: Level 6/10 (41%) (Passive) The cost of the Mana Shield decreases when focused on it. Increases even more when the Meditation skill is active.]
target: [Controlled Mana Shield: Gradus 6/10 (41%) (Passivum) – Sumptus Scuti Manae decrescit cum in eo incumbis. Augmentatur etiam cum ars Meditationis activa est.]

source: [Sustained Mana Shield: Level 1/10 (16%) (Passive) Thanks to the experience with maintaining the Mana Shield over a long time the cost of the Mana Shield decreases. 1% decrease per level.]
target: [Sustained Mana Shield: Gradus 1/10 (16%) (Passivum) – Gratias experientiae diuturnae scuti manae sustentandi, sumptus decrescit; 1% decrescitur pro gradu.]

source: [Basic Sword Mastery: Level 10/10 (MAX%) (Passive) Shows that the person is capable of wielding a sword. Mastering the basics will allow the user to start learning advanced moves. Slightly increases the damage you do with a sword.]
target: [Basic Sword Mastery: Gradus 10/10 (MAX%) (Passivum) – Ostendit te gladio uti posse. Fundamenta callens sinit ut usor mores provectos discere incipiat. Paululum damnum, quod gladio facis, auget.]

source: [Pinpoint Accuracy: Level 4/5 (65%) (Passive) Your strikes are extremely accurate. Accurate enough that sometimes they slip through the gaps of the armor of your enemies. +5% chance for an attack to deal True Damage that ignores armor]
target: [Pinpoint Accuracy: Gradus 4/5 (65%) (Passivum) – Ictus tui sunt valde exacti. Satis exacti ut interdum per intervalla armorum hostium evadant. +5% probabilitas ut impetus verus damnum, qui armaturam ignorat, inferat.]

source: [Intermediate Sword Mastery: Level 2/15 (7%) (Passive) Shows that the person is more than capable of wielding a sword. You’ve mastered the basics of the sword. It is time to improve upon it. Increases the damage done with swords, and decreases slightly the mana required for sword related skills.]
target: [Intermediate Sword Mastery: Gradus 2/15 (7%) (Passivum) – Ostendit te gladio uti plus quam idoneum. Fundamenta gladii didicisti. Tempus est meliora emendare: damnum gladiis facto augetur et manae impensa pro artibus gladii paululum decrescunt.]

source: [Stable Stance: Level 1/5 (54%) (Passive) Makes your stance when wielding a sword more stable. Enemies will have to use more power to unbalance your stance.]
target: [Stable Stance: Gradus 1/5 (54%) (Passivum) – Facit statum tuum dum gladio uteris stabiliorem. Hostes vires magis ad statum tuum inordinandum impetrabunt.]

source: [Basic Footwork: Level 3/10 (13%) (Passive) Proves you have gained knowledge about the basics of footwork. Your stance will be more stable, and you will use less stamina during a fight.]
target: [Basic Footwork: Gradus 3/10 (13%) (Passivum) – Demonstrat te notitiam fundamentalia mobilitatis pedum adeptum esse. Statum tuum stabilit et minus vigoris in pugna consumes.]

source: [Basic Breathing Technique: Level 6/10 (84%) (Passive) You have learned to control your breathing. Decreases stamina consumption during any activity.]
target: [Basic Breathing Technique: Gradus 6/10 (84%) (Passivum) – Discipulus es respirationem tuam moderandi. Consumptio vigoris in qualibet re decrescit.]

source: [Basic Mana Control: Level 10/10 (MAX%) (Passive) You managed to gain basic control over your own mana. Mastering this skill will allow you to learn more advanced techniques. This skill also increases the amount of mana regenerated at a time.]
target: [Basic Mana Control: Gradus 10/10 (MAX %) (Passive) – Potuisti moderationem manae fundamentalem adipisci. Per hanc artem artes provectiores discere poteris. Haec ars etiam quantitatem manae regenerationis auget.]

source: [Intermediate Mana Control: Level 15/15 (MAX%) (Passive) You understand the basic concepts of mana control. You can now do more, achieve more, and gain more while manipulating mana. The skill increases the amount of mana regenerated at a time and decreases the cost of mana skills by 14%. The bonuses from the Basic Mana Control remain. +6,3 Mana Regeneration per Second]
target: [Intermediate Mana Control: Gradus 15/15 (MAX%) (Passive) – Notiones fundamentales moderationis manae intellegis. Nunc plus efficere, plus assequi, et plus adipisci potes dum manam moderaris. Ars quantitatem manae regenerationis auget et impensa manae per 14% decrescit. Bonifica ex Basic Mana Control manent. +6,3 Mana Regeneratio per secundam.]

source: [Focused Mana Control: Level 5/5 (MAX%) (Passive) Mana control when meditating increases. Decreases skills mana cost and increases mana regeneration when under the effect of Meditation skill. Bonuses are increased when under the Deep Meditation skill’s effect!]
target: [Focused Mana Control: Gradus 5/5 (MAX%) (Passive) – Moderatio manae in meditatione augetur. Decrescit sumptus manae et regeneratio manae augetur cum Meditationis effectu. Bonifica sub Deep Meditation effectu augebantur!]

source: [Continuous Mana Control: Level MAX (Passive) The longer you control your mana, the more efficient it becomes. The cost of the mana control exercise cannot become zero.]
target: [Continuous Mana Control: Gradus MAX (Passive) – Quo diutius manam moderaris, eo efficacior fies. Sumptus exercitationis moderationis manae numquam in nihilum cadere potest.]

source: [Advanced Mana Control: Level 0/20 (0%) (Passive) You reached beyond the basics of mana control. You shape and bend mana to your will. The skill further increases the amount of mana regenerated at a time and decreases the cost of mana skills by 15%. The bonuses from the Basic and intermediate Mana Control remain. +6,5 Mana Regeneration per Second;]
target: [Advanced Mana Control: Gradus 0/20 (0%) (Passive) – Ultra fundamenta moderationis manae pervenisti. Manam secundum voluntatem tuam fingis et incurvas. Ars quantitatem manae regenerationis auget et impensa manae per 15% decrescit. Bonifica Basic et Intermediate Mana Control manent. +6,5 Mana Regeneratio per secundam;]

source: [Companion Sense: Level 20 (66%) This skill allows you to determine in which direction your companion is compared to you. With the improvement of the bond between you and your companion, the ability of this skill will also grow.]
target: [Companion Sense: Gradus 20 (66%) – Haec ars tibi permittit determinare quo loco comes tuus sit. Cum vinculum inter vos augeatur, capacitas artis crescet.]

source: [Deep Connection: Level MAX (Passive) Your companion has a bigger chance to learn skills related to or complementary to your skills upon leveling up.]
target: [Deep Connection: Gradus MAX (Passive) – Comes tuus maiorem facultatem habet ad artes cognatas aut complementarias tuis discendas cum gradu accrescit.]

source: [Meditation: Level 21/25 (19%) (Passive) You are skilled at meditation enough that when meditating, it allows you to increase your mana regeneration. Usage of the skill causes you to lose all of your senses. Improving the skill will allow you to gain back those senses. +2,4 Mana Regeneration per Second]
target: [Meditation: Gradus 21/25 (19%) (Passive) – Peritus es in meditatione ita ut dum meditaris, regenerationem manae augere possis. Usus artis omnes sensus amittit; emendatio autem sinit te eos recuperare. +2,4 Mana Regeneratio per secundam.]

source: [Deep Meditation: Level 5/5 (MAX%) (Passive) When you meditate, you meditate deep. After 10 minutes of meditation, you will enter into Deep Meditation that will double the Mana Regeneration granted by Meditation. Cooldown: 2 hours]
target: [Deep Meditation: Gradus 5/5 (MAX%) (Passive) – Cum meditaris, penitus meditaris. Post 10 minuta meditationis, in Deep Meditation introibis, quae duplicabit regenerationem manae concessam per Meditationem. Tempus Refrigerandi: 2 Horae]

source: [Mana Sense: Level 7/25 (0%) (Active/Passive) A skill that allows you to sense the mana in your surroundings and to make sense of any enchantment that you come across. It also allows you passively to detect magic that affects you.]
target: [Mana Sense: Gradus 7/25 (0%) (Active/Passive) – Haec ars tibi permittit manam circumstantem sentire atque incantationes intellegere. Simul tibi passiva sinit magiam quae te afficit detegere.]

source: [Multitasking: Level 20/100 (34%) (Passive) Enhances your ability to use two or more skills at once.]
target: [Multitasking: Gradus 20/100 (34%) (Passive) – Vestram facultatem ad duas vel plurimas artes simul uti auget.]

source: [Mana Synergy: Level 2/10 (6%) (Passive) Thanks to your combining compatible skills, you managed to find a synergy between them. This synergy is completely useless in battle, but when you train your skills and completely focus on them, the rewards from your training increase. When using two or more mana skills simultaneously outside of battle, the cost of their use is reduced by 3%, while you receive 1,3 times more experience in training.]
target: [Mana Synergy: Gradus 2/10 (6%) (Passive) – Gratias artium compatibilium coniunctione, inter eas synergiam inveni. Haec synergia in proelio omnino inutilis est, sed cum artes exerceas et totum animum illis impingas, praemia disciplinae augentur. Utiendo duabus vel pluribus artibus manae simul extra proelium, sumptus usus per 3% decrescit, dum experientia disciplinae 1,3 vicibus maior accipitur.]

source: [Mana Well: Level 1/5 (1%) You grasped something deep and abstract. Mana is like clay in your hand. Your body is a wellspring of Mana. Increases how much mana a Magic status point grants you. Current increase: Quadruples the base growth.]
target: [Mana Well: Gradus 1/5 (1%) – Profundum et abstractum aliquid percepisti. Mana sicut argilla in manu tua est. Corpus tuum fons manae est. Quantitatem manae a puncto statu magico tribuenda auget. Incrementum currente: Basim quadruplitat.]

source: [Calm Heart: Level 3/50 (4%) You are the epitome of keeping calm and carrying on. You will have an easier time staying calm and focused. Increases resistance against mind-altering effects.]
target: [Calm Heart: Gradus 3/50 (4%) – Tu es exemplum tranquillitatis et constantiae. Facilius mansurus eris tranquillus et concentratus. Resistentia adversus effectus mentis mutantes augetur.]

source: [Light Ball: Level 4/10 (5%) (Active) A simple spell that allows you to conjure a ball of light to illuminate your surroundings.]
target: [Light Ball: Gradus 4/10 (5%) (Active) – Incantatio simplex quae tibi concedit globum lucis evocare ad circumstantia illuminanda.]

source: [Firespark: Level 2/10 (14%) (Active) A simple spell that allows you to conjure a spark of fire to start fires.]
target: [Firespark: Gradus 2/10 (14%) (Active) – Incantatio simplex quae tibi concedit scintillam ignis evocare ad focos accendendos.]

source: [Condense Water: Level 3/10 (27%) (Active) A simple spell that allows you to condense water from the surrounding air.]
target: [Condense Water: Gradus 3/10 (27%) (Active) – Incantatio simplex quae tibi concedit aquam ex aere circumstanti condensare.]

source: [Clean: Level 6/10 (87%) (Active) A simple spell that allows you to clean a selected surface.]
target: [Clean: Gradus 6/10 (87%) (Active) – Incantatio simplex quae tibi concedit superficiem electam purgare.]

source: [Mage Sight: Level 1/10 (69%) (Active) A spell that allows you to visually observe the currents of magic.]
target: [Mage Sight: Gradus 1/10 (69%) (Active) – Incantatio quae tibi permittit fluxus magiae videre.]

source: [Mana Strike: Level 2/10 (11%) (Active) Allows you to enhance the damage of your strikes be it unarmed or with weapon.]
target: [Mana Strike: Gradus 2/10 (11%) (Active) – Permittit tibi damnum ictuum tuorum, sive sine armis sive cum armis, augere.]

source: [Mana Slash: Level 6/10 (17%) (Active) Allows you to enhance the damage of your slashes with any weapon capable of slashing.]
target: [Mana Slash: Gradus 6/10 (17%) (Active) – Permittit tibi damnum ictuum tuorum in caedibus cum quolibet armamento augere.]

source: [Mana Body Enhancement: Level 11/100 (69%) (Active) During usage enhances the physical attributes by 6% (STR, AGI, DEX, END).]
target: [Mana Body Enhancement: Gradus 11/100 (69%) (Active) – Usus huius incantationis omnes attributos físicos (STR, AGI, DEX, END) per 6% auget.]

source: [Dwarven Language: Level 3/10 (21%) (Passive) You managed to learn the basics of the Dwarven language.]
target: [Dwarven Language: Gradus 3/10 (21%) (Passive) – Fundamenta linguae Nanorum didicisti.]

source: [Elven Language: Level 1/10 (8%) (Passive) You managed to learn the basics of the Elven language.]
target: [Elven Language: Gradus 1/10 (8%) (Passive) – Fundamenta linguae Elfonum adeptus es.]
